description: Align a repository with MadeBy in one call: create .madeby/policy.json (advisory by default — reports, never fails) and the CI disclosure check for the host (github or azure-devops, worked out from an earlier CI file or the git remote when not given). Idempotent — never clobbers an existing policy or workflow; the one change it makes is mode: "required" raising an existing advisory policy to required (it never lowers one). Returns the files created/skipped and the recommended next steps. Read the resources: madeby://guide/align (full workflow), madeby://guide/enforce (make the check required — the host's control plane, exact commands), madeby://guide/backfill (account for existing history honestly — never fabricate). The ACO convention block is versioned: the result flags an `outdated` AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md (drift); call again with update:true to refresh just that block in place — how an agent keeps the convention current. update:true also moves the madeby pin in the CI file init generated (`pinned`); `pinOutdated` flags one left behind.

claude_code.description: set Claude Code's commit trailer in .claude/settings.json even if the repo shows no sign of Claude Code (it is set automatically when there is a CLAUDE.md or .claude/). A value the team already set is never changed.

host.description: CI host to wire: github or azure-devops. Omit it to keep the host of a CI file init wrote earlier, else the git remote's; GitHub only when neither says (reported in hostSource)

merges.description: add the merges line to the AGENTS.md rule (each developer's agent suggests the per-clone merge declaration) even without signs the repo resolves conflicts in merge commits. Added automatically when recent history has such merges, or for host azure-devops.

path.description: path to the repo (default: the server's working directory)

record_model.description: opt in: ask AI disclosures to also name the model version (tool:model) — policy recordModel + an AGENTS.md line. Never turned off by init; default false.

update.description: refresh an outdated ACO convention block in place (drift update); default false (report only)

name: init
